agent_notes: The supplied NIRF 2025 College Ranking ALL page lists the exact institution name with Mandla city and Madhya Pradesh state.

The official e-Pravesh college record identifies Govt College, Anjaniya as a government, co-educational college in Mandla district and points its Website field to the official highereducation.mp.gov.in profile.
The official profile exposes separate Regular Courses and Distance Education Courses catalogue pages. The distance page repeats M. A. (Sociology); it is represented once as a unique programme.
No duration is stated on the reviewed official catalogue pages. Distance-course minimum-qualification cells are blank, so those eligibility fields remain null.

The local career tree has no Geography leaf and no M.A. subject leaves; Geography uses the Social Sciences & Education nearest parent and M.A. subjects use closest discipline nodes with medium confidence.

The managed proxy returned the exact self-signed certificate-chain error on the first HTTPS request; after confirming the expected official hostnames, curl --insecure was used for public official profile/catalogue retrieval. No credentials or private data were sent.
Search-engine results were used only for discovery and were not treated as verification evidence.
